text:
maya: Trying to spin up a new GPU nodepool in asia-south2 for inference burst. Need 8x H100s MIG-friendly. Can infra provision? Also NAT egress IPs are tight.

jin: Can you paste required instance types/taints? Also want to confirm whether we need MIG or whole-GPU.

maya: We need MIG for inference workloads to reduce cost, 8x h100-v5, but provider API says MIG not supported on the h100 flavor in this region. Fallback: a10g or full H100 nodes?

frank: Oof. asia-south2 recently rolled an image where H100s are only whole-gpu. Check `gcloud compute accelerator-types list --zones=asia-south2*` — that's what I saw last week.

maya: Ran a quick check, see `Accelerator types: h100-whole, a10g-mig` — so a10g supports MIG. But perf for our 4k-token model is noticeably worse in perf tests.

sam: Also we have only 2 NAT egress IPs left in VPC, adding new pool will need more egress. Ops quota request in progress? @provision-bot do we have spare NAT IPs?

provision-bot: NAT IPs remaining in org-vpc-prod: 2. Requested new NATs from cloud queued (ticket #4621).

jin: If NATs delayed, we could enable VPC internet egress via shared egress or use cloud NAT with ephemeral, but security wants fixed egress for customers.

cost-ops: Note: H100 whole nodes cost ~3.4x a10g on hourly list. If we use a mixed strategy, reserve 2 whole H100 for low-latency burst and use a10g-mig for scale.

maya: Cluster-autoscaler behavior question: if nodepool uses whole GPU and taint `gpux=true:NoSchedule`, will CA scale up on GPU pod requests? Our recent job backlog showed CA delay of ~3 minutes.

sam: We've seen CA not scaling for pods requesting `nvidia.com/gpu:1` if `--balance-similar-node-groups` not tuned. Also scale-up is suppressed if node resource binpacking prevents packing multiple pods per node.

frank: Logs from last backlog (snippet):
```
I0303 12:34:21 scale_up.go:312] Pod default/train-xyz can't be scheduled: Insufficient resources: nvidia.com/gpu
I0303 12:37:10 scale_up.go:410] No feasible nodes after evaluation
```

jin: Proposal: create new nodepool `asia-south2-infer-a10g-mig` (min=2 max=12, 6 nodes planned initially, mig profiles mix 1g.5g), taint `infer=true:NoSchedule`, node affinity label `node.kubernetes.io/instance-type=a10g-mig`. Also create `asia-south2-infer-h100-reserve` (min=2 max=6, whole GPU) for low-latency.

maya: Can we set CA expander to `least-waste` and `--scale-up-delay=15s` for that cluster to reduce delay?

sam: Scale-up delay 15s ok but watch for flapping. Also set `--scale-down-unneeded-time=10m`. And make sure `--max-empty-bulk-delete=5` is tuned.

provision-bot: Preflight checks:
- GPU quota for region: GPUs used 120 / quota 128
- vCPU quota: 1800 / 2000
- Public IP quota: 48 / 50
- Network egress IPs: 2 / 4
Result: need public IP quota bump and NAT IPs. Opening ticket to cloud provider.

maya: Ticket number and cost estimate pls.

provision-bot: Ticket #PROV-2026-87 opened to request +8 GPUs quota, +10 Public IPs, +4 NAT IPs. ETA ~72 hours. Cost delta rough estimate: additional ~$18k/mo if we keep 8 H100 whole. Mixed approach: +a10g-mig only ~$6k/mo. See pricing link: https://provider.example/pricing/gpus

jin: I'll draft terraform changes for nodepools with taints and autoscaler flags, but will wait for NAT IPs before applying. @frank can you review TF? I'll ping when ready.

frank: Happy to review, please add nodepool labels and a new `nodePoolResourceGroup` for egress tracking. Also include a small `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }` guard on the reserve pool.

maya: If NATs delayed beyond 72h, can we route inference traffic via a dedicated proxy in us-east1 temporarily?

sam: Possible but adds cross-region latency. For small ML inference it might be ok (~120ms added) and cheaper than blocking rollout. Need to add route and update SLO docs.

maya: :thumbsup: thanks everyone — putting a hold on rollout until provider ticket is in progress.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: Created PR #6823 for `asia-south2` nodepool TF. Status: draft.
